Contract CoCoMESystem::openStore(storeID:Integer): Boolean {
          definition:
          store:Set(Store) = Store.allInstance()->any(s | s.Id = storeID)
            
            precondition:
          store->notEmpty() and store.oclIsUndefined() = false and store.isOpen = false
            
            postcondition:
          CurrentStore = store and store.oclIsNew() = false and store->includes(CurrentStore) and store.isOpen = true
            
        }
